from.place: Evaluation-normalized natural currying on K-flat representatives

title: Evaluation-normalized natural currying on K-flat representatives
statement: Let (C,J) be a small site and R a sheaf of commutative rings, and use its module-sheaf category and an unbounded derived category. If L and P are K-flat cochain complexes [def-pc-kflat-complex], there is a specified isomorphism RHom(QL,RHom(QP,N)) ≅ RHom(Q Tot(L tensor P),N) for every unbounded derived N [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. It is natural in both contravariant K-flat complexes and the covariant derived target. Construct it by the degreewise pure-tensor evaluation map, its differential compatibility and naturality [lem-sc-hom-tensor-degreewise, lem-sc-hom-tensor-differential, lem-sc-hom-tensor-naturality], using actual functorial K-injective target models and localization comparisons. For a K-injective I, Hom(P,I) is K-injective [lem-pur-hom-kflat-into-kinjective], which gives the representative comparison for nested Hom.

proof.text: Use the actual functorial K-injective resolution and the localization factorization to compare derived Hom with its chosen chain model. For an already K-injective target, invert its resolution coaugmentation under Q; naturality gives a natural comparison.
The degreewise currying map is an isomorphism and respects the differential, so forms a chain isomorphism. Its three-variable naturality gives a natural isomorphism of the representative functors.

For K-flat L and K-injective I, Hom(L,I) is K-injective. Apply the representative comparisons twice to compute nested Hom, compose with chain currying, and descend through the fully faithful precomposition functor induced by derived localization of the target.
